issue.title: Physical-device readiness checklist after Maestro coverage
issue.body:
## Why

#717 builds Maestro coverage for the current Legacy Android UI. Pinning one APK and running that coverage on a physical device is a later readiness pass. It is not acceptance for #717.

## Acceptance

- [ ] After #717 has device evidence, name the exact APK (build id and commit) under test.
- [ ] Run the agreed physical checklist on a lower-end Android device and record PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED per case.
- [ ] A missing device is BLOCKED, not a pass.

Refs #717. Do not start this while #717 still has no device run.
